question.value: Are M-dwarf debris discs intrinsically less common than around earlier types, or just hard to detect at the wavelengths and sensitivities of earlier far-IR surveys? Tested with an ALMA Band 7 survey of BPMG M-dwarfs.

claims.hypothesis: M-dwarf debris discs are intrinsically less common than around earlier-type stars
